thread:
Maria: quick sync — launching the micro-webinar + starter credit play tomorrow. need final copy for launch post and routing rules.
Jon: timeline check — landing page up at 11:00 PT, webinar at 14:00 PT. social posts 11:05, email 11:15. is credit gating live?
Maria: credit gate = 30 starter credits. goal: low friction, measurable lift vs control.
Kevin: two headline variants for social A/B:
Kevin: A) "Ship with AI: Get 30 Starter Credits + Webinar"
Kevin: B) "Build Faster with Redwood — Join the Webinar + Free Credits"
Tara: I prefer B for dev tone. A sounds too product-y.
Camille: prompt template packs ready — 3 starter packs: "docs-to-app", "agent-prototype", "chat-integration". i'll attach links in the email.
Maria: perfect. Jon — confirm routing. we want webinar signups from dev channels to hit a dev-nurture path with hands-on prompt pack + credit drip.
Jon: routing plan:
Jon: - inbound from webinar page -> tag:webinar -> route:nurture-webinar-seq
Jon: - if tag:webinar and ref=dev-channel -> route:dev-path + immediate credit email
Jon: - holdout (25%) -> no credits for benchmark
Jon: experiment config:
Jon: ```
Jon: experiment: starter_credit_microwebinar_2026
Jon: arms: control, credit_immediate, credit_drip
Jon: metrics: activation_7d, avg_tokens_week1, demo_requests
Jon: target_sample: 2000
Jon: ```
Maria: Camille, can you include the prompt packs in the credit_immediate email? callout to "one-click deploy" + code snippet.
Camille: sure. deploy CTA snippet:
Camille: ```
Camille: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/deploy \
Camille:   -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
Camille:   -d '{"template":"docs-to-app","name":"quickstart"}'
Camille: ```
Kevin: need short email subject variants for testing — keep concise:
Kevin: 1) "30 free credits + live walkthrough"
Kevin: 2) "Free credits inside — build with Redwood after the webinar"
Tara: test both. 1 reads more urgent.
Maria: tagging @growth @sales @devrel — support on standby. also set rollback if activation drops or spam complaints > 0.5%.
Jon: will add console alert and token-cost flag to monitor unit economics by arm.
Camille: i can finish email copy + attach prompt packs in ~90 minutes. will add one-click deploy buttons.
Maria: social post should link to a short benchmark tease: "See ~2x inference speed at ~1/3 the cost in our demo (average)" — ok?
Kevin: accurate for dedicated configs. add "on average" is good.
growth-bot: webinar registration triggered: registrants=0 (bot will update counts as people sign up)
Maria: thanks — i'll publish assets and ping when live :rocket:
